visible_text: 若 z 随 x 反变且随 y 的立方正变，则下列何者必为常数？ A. xy^3z B. x^3yz^3 C. y^3/(xz) D. y/(x^3z^3)
reasoning: Since z varies inversely with x and directly with the cube of y, we have z = k * y^3 / x for some constant k. Substituting into each option shows that only option C simplifies to 1/k, a constant, while the other expressions remain variable.
